17	SUMMARY: Identity component and degree-zero points. Two sorries in Picard/IdentityComponent.lean: finrank_eq_genus (:1896) and kPoints_iff_kerDegree (:1939). The degree map itself is BUILT and sorry-free (PicScheme.degree :1702, pinned via ClassDegreePinned with a non-vacuity test), the Pic^0 inclusion is BUILT, and the easy direction of the kernel characterisation is landed (degree_eq_zero_of_class_eq_zero :1733); the open half is the converse. This kills the "uniform cotangent bound" that three earlier rows (r5, r6) named as the <= half's open content -- it was never a separate piece of mathematics here. Since the value at the identity is an EQUALITY, one point serves both directions:    topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous -- AXIOM-CLEAN, gives dim Pic^0 = g from   (i) the cotangent value at the identity, (ii) regularity of that one stalk, (iii) the   orbit condition.    topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous_of_regular -- discharges (i) from front (a)   verbatim, since genus C is DEFINED as the H^1 finrank (Genus.lean:41). Reports sorryAx,   inherited from front (a) alone, with the clean sibling above it as the control.  *** RETRACTED (run 0067 r8, commit 27f526ea7): EVERYTHING ABOVE FROM "THE DIMENSION HALF IS NOW REDUCED" IS WRONG. THE ORBIT CONDITION IS NOT A GAP -- IT IS CONTRADICTORY FOR g >= 1, so both topologicalKrullDim_eq_genus_of_homogeneous theorems are VACUOUS exactly where the A.3 leg exists, and the uniform cotangent bound the r7 row declared dead is REINSTATED as owed. ***  Picard/HomogeneityOrbitCollapse.lean proves topologicalKrullDim_eq_zero_of_homogeneous: the orbit condition ALONE forces topologicalKrullDim Pic^0 = 0, hence genus_eq_zero_of_homogeneous gives genus C = 0. No hypothesis on k. Three steps: a translation is an ISO of schemes hence a homeomorphism; the identity point is CLOSED (a section of a morphism to Spec k is a closed immersion with singleton range); a homeomorphism carries closed points to closed points. So "every point is a translate of the identity" makes every point closed = T1, and a nonempty SOBER T1 space has topologicalKrullDim 0.  FOURTH WRONG FRAMING of this leg; the r7 text above superseded the third. The tell was already in this project: identityComponent_irreducibleSpace_of_isAlgClosed (IdentityComponent.lean:866) translates through CLOSED points then needs JACOBSON DENSITY to sweep up the non-closed ones -- the step a rational orbit cannot supply. REUSABLE RULE: an orbit of rational points cannot cover a scheme; use a COVER (AJCR's smoothOfRelativeDimension_of_translation_cover quantifies over a ZeroHypercover), not an orbit of points.  WHAT IS ACTUALLY OWED: front (a); regularity at the identity (free over a perfect field via isRegularLocalRing_stalk_of_smooth_of_perfectField, a hypothesis so the statement stays over an arbitrary field per I-0491); and the UNIFORM COTANGENT BOUND, needing a transport that reaches NON-CLOSED points -- an extension-valued translation or a density argument. SURVIVES r7 untouched: the cotangent-invariance theorems (finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_of_ringEquiv, finrank_cotangentSpace_stalk_eq_of_isIso), which concern a single isomorphism.  NOTE finrank_eq_genus HAS ZERO CONSUMERS and sits UPSTREAM of the dimension machinery in the import graph (IdentityComponent imports only FGAPicRepresentability/GeometricallyConnectedSection/ DivDegree/Genus). Closing it in place would need an import inversion; the live statement of the same mathematics is the Pic0Dimension/GroupSchemeHomogeneity pair. Do not price it as the blocker.  SEARCH DATUM worth reusing: mathlib v4.31 has NO functoriality for IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace -- no map along a ring homomorphism of any kind. Transport a cotangent dimension via Submodule.spanFinrank (Ideal.spanRank_map_le both ways + antisymmetry, no Noetherian needed) then Nakayama. AJC's own spanFinrank_maximalIdeal_le_of_surjective is `private`.

31	SUMMARY: WHICH TOWER THIS ROW IS ABOUT -- added by review-ajc 2026-07-29, because everything below is written about the side no curve inhabits, and a prover reading it would spend the round under an uninhabited class.  Both line numbers cited below (Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:1135 geometricallyReduced, :1373 universallyClosed) carry [HasPicScheme C]. That class has ZERO instances: its only producer is the conditional picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint, and hasRationalPoint_of_curve was deleted as FALSE (protection I-0491). Kernel-measured census: 76 binder sites on [HasPicScheme C] vs 15 on [HasPicSchemeEt C], no declaration binding both (I-0938). So discharging the two sorries below proves something about no curve until a rational point is supplied.  THE HEADLINE'S COUNTERPARTS, which are the ones under picardJacobianWitness: Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced (Picard/Pic0Et.lean:174) and Pic0Et.universallyClosed (:227), both carrying [HasPicSchemeEt C], which IS unconditionally inhabited (instHasPicSchemeEt, a projection of the central sorry). They are two of the five obligations named on AJC.jacobian.assembly.  THE MATHEMATICS BELOW IS NOT WASTED -- it TRANSFERS, and one half is free. MEASURED by review-ajc in a scratch file, lake env lean EXIT=0, zero diagnostics (I-0944): the kbar reduction this row records is NOT specific to Pic0Scheme. Its engine smooth_of_grpObj_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange (Picard/GroupSchemeSmoothAlgClosed.lean:156) binds an arbitrary group scheme, and Pic0Et proves both of its binders unconditionally (locallyOfFiniteType :127, grpObj :104). So    IsReduced (Pic0SchemeEt C x_k kbar)  =>  Smooth (Pic0SchemeEt C).hom   AND  GeometricallyReduced (...)  both elaborate in three lines, the second discharging the sorry at Pic0Et.lean:174. The two-for-one collapse recorded below therefore holds on the headline tower too. TRAP: Pic0Et.lean's import cone (FGAPicRepresentability + IdentityComponent) does NOT see the Smooth.geometricallyReduced instance -- add import AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.GeometricallyReduced or synthesis fails and you will wrongly conclude the bridge is absent. Pic0AbelianVariety.lean:1209-1213 records that same lesson for its own version; the trap re-fired one level up.  STILL OWED either way: IsReduced (Pic0Et x_k kbar) is the real mathematics (Kleiman s5 cor:sm, Cartier) and is a hypothesis in both probes. ajc-p3 confirms no Cartier and no CharZero-reducedness result exists under Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry, so this is genuine content and not a missing import.  THE PROPERNESS CAVEAT IS RETIRED -- it was MY hedge and ajc-p3 measured past it (I-1032, 2026-07-29). This row said "the PROPERNESS half is NOT measured to transfer ... so do not assume it". It does transfer: QuasiCompact is free from isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible.2.1, so UniversallyClosed.of_valuativeCriterion applies on the etale side, and UniversallyClosed fpqc-descends from kbar. Measured with imports rebuilt first (lake build EXIT=0, 8625 jobs; then lake env lean EXIT=0), which matters here because this row already records the import trap that makes the bridge look absent.  WITH THE NEGATIVE RESULT THAT BOUNDS IT, and it is the part a lane must not skip: IsProper itself has NO DescendsAlong instance for (Surjective inf Flat inf QuasiCompact) at v4.31. Only the UniversallyClosed conjunct descends. So "properness transfers" means the conjunct this row's sorry actually names, not IsProper as a whole.  A lane taking this row should say which tower it is proving, and prefer the Et one.  --- ORIGINAL SUMMARY, mathematics unchanged and still correct on its own terms ---  Smoothness, properness, and irreducibility. TWO sorries in Picard/Pic0AbelianVariety.lean: geometricallyReduced (:1135) and universallyClosed (:1373). Both are fully reduced -- the structural assembly is discharged and each is now a single named geometric input. Geometric irreducibility and the GrpObj structure are already THEOREMS, not obligations.  SMOOTHNESS: one hypothesis suffices, and it is a statement about a SINGLE scheme. IsReduced of Pic^0 x_k Spec kbar gives smoothness (smooth_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange, resting on mathlib's smooth_of_grpObj which already contains BOTH the translation argument and the descent along Spec kbar -> Spec k) AND it discharges geometricallyReduced itself (geometricallyReduced_of_isReduced_algebraicClosureBaseChange, via Smooth.geometricallyReduced). So the two apparently independent obligations collapse to one. Do not state a version quantified over all field extensions: GeometricallyReduced has NO MorphismProperty.DescendsAlong instance in mathlib v4.31 (checked here and independently by AJCR, I-0495), so the general->kbar reduction is not available from mathlib -- but this project owns the converse through Curve/GeometricallyReduced.lean, which is what makes the single-scheme form legitimate. Mathematics owed: Kleiman section 5 cor:sm -- H^2(C,O_C) = 0 on a curve makes the deformation functor of an invertible sheaf unobstructed. Characteristic-free BECAUSE dim C = 1 (Pic_{X/k} can be non-smooth in char p for surfaces -- Igusa).  PROPERNESS HAS EXACTLY ONE LIVE ROUTE, and two are refuted:  * LIVE: universallyClosed_of_valuativeCriterion. Needs ValuativeCriterion.Existence of    (Pic0Scheme C).hom; the QuasiCompact side condition mathlib's criterion wants is already a    theorem here. Through representability a Spec R-point IS a relative Picard class, so the    lifting statement is the concrete assertion that an invertible sheaf on C x_k Spec K extends    over the valuation ring -- the classical content of properness, and the same species as    DualNumber.free_of_cyclic_mod_eps.  * REFUTED, do not retry: the ambient route. Universal closedness of Pic_{C/k} is not merely hard,    it is FALSE -- it forces CompactSpace on an infinite disjoint union over deg in Z    (Picard/AmbientPicNotProper.lean, 5 declarations, axiom-clean). This does NOT affect the    Pic^0 statement: Pic^0 is quasi-compact, Pic is not.  * REFUTED on vocabulary: the quasi-projectivity route (Kleiman th:qpp&p). Mathlib v4.31 has no    quasi-projectivity API at all, which is also why smoothProperQuotient is unprovable as stated    (I-0074 Caveat 2 -- and do NOT reintroduce a global instance for it).  MEASURE AT A SYNTHESIS SITE. smooth/proper and all their reductions quantify over [HasPicScheme C] and therefore report CLEAN axioms at the declaration while the caller's synthesis supplies sorryAx. Every clean claim in this leg has been probed against controls that DO fire sorryAx; keep that discipline or the completeness number is fiction.

44	SUMMARY: ROUTE CORRECTION 2026-07-29 (review-ajc): THE CAMPAIGN'S DESCENT STEP TARGETS A FALSE STATEMENT. Read this before choosing a target under this node. Corrected twice the same day; this is the settled version.  THE FACT, now a Lean theorem reduced to one named residue. ajc-p1's PicScheme.not_exists_representing_picSharp_of_not_isIso (Picard/PicEtSubcanonical.lean:427) proves that if picEtComparison C fails to be an isomorphism then NO scheme represents picSharp C -- the EXISTENTIAL of clause (1), not a pinned candidate -- with no topology and no sheaf step in the argument. Axiom-clean. Kleiman supplies the curve, L5105-L5108 (repeated L5126-L5129) in references/kleiman-picard-src/kleiman-picard.tex: the conic u^2+v^2+w^2=0 in P^2_R, a smooth plane conic and hence SMOOTH, PROPER, GEOMETRICALLY INTEGRAL over a field where it has NO rational point -- exactly this project's binders -- with Pic_{(X/R)et} representable by s4 th:main and the two functors differing (ex:Pfs). So UNCONDITIONAL representability of picSharp over an arbitrary field is FALSE, not merely open. THE ONE UNFORMALISED STEP, stated so nobody reads this as closed: that the comparison really does fail for that conic (via phi^*O(1) and h0 on P^1_C).  THE CONSEQUENCE. The campaign's last two milestones claim exactly that: G3 concludes "J_r := J'_r/Gamma represents picSharpDeg C r OVER k" and G4 assembles picSharpDeg. Those two AS WRITTEN aim at a false statement. Corrected in informal/pic-representability-campaign.md at G3.  DO NOT REBUILD THIS VIA A ZARISKI-SHEAF ARGUMENT -- two citations have already been wrong in that slot (I-0970, I-0973, and the lesson is worth more than the fact):  * the seam's original "picSharp is not even a Zariski sheaf (Kleiman s2 L1292-L1302)" cites lines    about the ABSOLUTE functor Pic_X. The relative functor quotients by Pic(T) precisely to defeat    that argument. /-- A **rank-`d` quotient of `O_T^r`** on a scheme `T`: a sheaf of modules `F` on `T`,
locally free of rank `d`, together with an epimorphism `q : O_T^r ↠ F`. This is the
unbundled datum whose equivalence classes form the value of the Grassmannian functor. -/
structure RankQuotient (r d : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{0}) where
  /-- The quotient sheaf. -/
  F : T.Modules
  /-- The quotient map out of the trivial rank-`r` bundle. -/
  q : SheafOfModules.free (R := T.ringCatSheaf) (Fin r) ⟶ F
  /-- The quotient map is an epimorphism (surjective). -/
  epi : Epi q
  /-- The quotient sheaf is locally free of rank `d`. -/
  locFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank F d

/-- Two rank-`d` quotients are **equivalent** when there is an isomorphism of the targets
commuting with the quotient maps (equivalently, when the kernels of the quotient maps
coincide). -/
def RankQuotient.Rel {r d : ℕ} {T : Scheme.{0}} (x y : RankQuotient r d T) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : x.F ≅ y.F, x.q ≫ f.hom = y.q
